title: List all running applications with details
summary: Use the `lsappinfo` command to see a detailed list of all applications currently running on your Mac. This is useful for debugging or seeing exactly what is active in the background.

steps.explain: Run the `lsappinfo list` command to display a comprehensive list of all running applications and their current state.
steps.expect: A long list of application names and their internal identifiers will appear in the terminal.
